subject: english
prompt: You meet your host family for the first time at 7 p.m. Which greeting is most appropriate?

options.text: Good evening. It is nice to meet you.
Good night. Wake me up now.

answer.explanation: At a first meeting in the evening, Good evening and It is nice to meet you are polite and appropriate.

solutionStrategy: Use both the time of day and the relationship, a first meeting, to select the greeting.
solutionSteps: Identify the social situation: meeting the host family for the first time.
Choose an evening greeting and a first-meeting courtesy.
Reject goodbye, impossible time wording, and demanding language.
Select A because it fits both context clues.
